title: The First Account
subtitle: A command that makes a scoreboard objective
description: A command reward is the escape hatch every pack reaches for, and
this one reaches for the scoreboard: it creates the
`first_light_standing` objective the festival's reward is gated on.
That is the honest way to demonstrate a score condition -- the
objective has to exist before anything can read it.
The festival hangs off this quest in the dependency graph, so a
player meets the objective before the gate that asks about it.
